name: Dependency receipts, baselines, comparators, diff and state
scope: Persist DependencyReceipt from tracked reads/explicit rules.

pre_execution_questions.question: Как хранить baseline snapshots: per-target files или content-addressed blobs?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Определяет deduplication, history and ease of repair.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Content-addressed normalized blobs referenced by receipts; target history lives in receipts/events.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Content-addressed normalized blobs referenced by receipts; target history lives in receipts/events.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt this implementation default for v0.1 unless implementation evidence exposes a contradiction.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.question: Какие comparators обязательны в v0.1?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Нельзя корректно diff-ить scalar, sets and Markdown одной exact-строкой.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt this implementation default for v0.1 unless implementation evidence exposes a contradiction.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.question: Должен ли `check` изменять dependency state?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: CLI contract сейчас допускает mutation; надо закрепить границу query/command.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Yes: `check` is a command that updates detected runtime state/events but never canonical content or validated baselines.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Проверка зависимостей должна при обнаружении изменения сразу отражать stale/review состояние; semantic validity затем проверяет пользователь/AI.
pre_execution_questions.decision: `check` обновляет runtime dependency state/events, но не canonical content и не validated baseline.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.question: Какие status значения считаем каноническими?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: От них зависят CLI, verify и AI workflow.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: At least `valid`, `stale`, `build_required`, `review_required`, `invalid`; `stale` may be umbrella in human text but machine state uses the more specific state when known.
pre_execution_questions.answer: At least `valid`, `stale`, `build_required`, `review_required`, `invalid`; `stale` may be umbrella in human text but machine state uses the more specific state when known.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt this implementation default for v0.1 unless implementation evidence exposes a contradiction.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.question: Нормализуем ли Markdown перед baseline/hash в v0.1?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Whitespace-only changes могут создавать шум, но сложная normalization может скрыть meaningful edits.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Use raw UTF-8 normalized line endings for v0.1 text comparator; add AST-aware comparator later.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Use raw UTF-8 normalized line endings for v0.1 text comparator; add AST-aware comparator later.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt this implementation default for v0.1 unless implementation evidence exposes a contradiction.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Must be resolved before phase acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.question: Как P3 должен учитывать изменение builder/helper code при неизменных data dependencies?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Derivation logic lives in code; without code revision a changed formula could remain falsely valid until an unrelated data change.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Persist the P2 builder_revision/source revision in builder receipts/state and compare it during check; revision change produces build_required for deterministic targets.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Persist the P2 builder_revision/source revision in builder receipts/state and compare it during check; revision change produces build_required for deterministic targets.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Treat builder source revision as a first-class invalidation input in P3.

pre_execution_questions.question: What exactly does a whole structured resource dependency snapshot/compare in P3: domain data only or the entire managed JSON envelope?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Engine metadata such as materialization destination should not accidentally invalidate a formula unless whole-resource semantics intentionally include it.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Treat resource://<id> dependency value as the entire domain data object/array. Engine envelope metadata is ownership/runtime metadata and needs a separate explicit dependency mechanism if it ever affects derivation.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Use the entire domain data object/array as the v0.1 whole structured-resource baseline; do not let unrelated $docengine materialization metadata drive derivation invalidation.
pre_execution_questions.decision: P3 baselines/diffs for whole structured resources operate on domain data, while observed source/version metadata may remain diagnostic evidence.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: Required to make P3-A1/P3-A3 dependency granularity deterministic and avoid metadata-only false invalidation.

pre_execution_questions.question: How precise must builder code revision invalidation be in v0.1?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: P2 hashes the whole top-level project Python package, which is safe but can mark unrelated builders as changed.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Keep the conservative package-wide source revision for v0.1 and expose the reason clearly; finer per-builder/helper code dependency tracking is a later optimization.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Use the package-wide content revision in v0.1. Accept possible extra build_required targets rather than risk missing helper-code changes.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Correctness-first conservative code invalidation for v0.1; revisit granularity only with evidence of excessive rebuild noise.
pre_execution_questions.acceptance_impact: P3-A7 may conservatively affect more targets, but must never miss a code-only change in the loaded project package.

emergent_questions.question: Should read-only dependency query commands create `_dependency` directories when none exist?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Creating state during inspection would violate command/query boundaries and make AI diagnostics mutate untouched documentation.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. Read-only commands must inspect without creating runtime directories.
emergent_questions.answer: No. Read-only commands must inspect without creating runtime directories.
emergent_questions.decision: `status`, `diff`, `explain`, `history`, and `graph` remain read-only. Stores create parent directories only on actual writes.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Resolved within P3 acceptance; no user decision required.

emergent_questions.question: How should P3 classify a target when a required source or current builder cannot be loaded?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Treating unavailable evidence as an ordinary changed value would overstate what comparison proved.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Use `invalid`, preserving the diagnostic reason (`source_unavailable` or `builder_unavailable`).
emergent_questions.answer: Use `invalid`, preserving the diagnostic reason (`source_unavailable` or `builder_unavailable`).
emergent_questions.decision: Unavailable evidence is not a semantic diff. P3 records `invalid` until the source/builder can be inspected again.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Resolved within P3 acceptance; no user decision required.

emergent_questions.question: Can a P2 build with `audit_complete=false` be persisted as `valid` in P3?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Untracked accesses mean the persisted dependency set is known to be incomplete.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. Preserve the receipt for diagnostics but state must be `invalid` with `audit_incomplete`.
emergent_questions.answer: No. Preserve the receipt for diagnostics but state must be `invalid` with `audit_incomplete`.
emergent_questions.decision: P3 never labels an incompletely tracked build as valid.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Resolved within P3 acceptance; no user decision required.

emergent_questions.question: Should P3 invent a virtual ref syntax for `field_set` or `collection` granularities?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: The conceptual registry mentions them, but v0.1 canonical refs currently address fields, resources and files only.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. Aggregate builders persist the many exact canonical refs they consumed; virtual collection addressing is deferred until there is a real addressing contract.
emergent_questions.answer: No. Aggregate builders persist the many exact canonical refs they consumed; virtual collection addressing is deferred until there is a real addressing contract.
emergent_questions.decision: Executable v0.1 receipt granularity is limited to `field`, `resource`, and `whole_file`; conceptual aggregate semantics remain supported through multiple edges.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Resolved within P3 acceptance; no user decision required.

emergent_questions.question: Should persisted status/history/graph diagnostics require the current project builder package to import successfully?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Diagnostics are most valuable when current code is broken; coupling them to builder import would hide history during failures.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: No. Persisted status/history/graph read only dependency state. `check/diff/explain` attempt current builders but degrade to explicit unavailable diagnostics instead of erasing state.
emergent_questions.answer: No. Persisted status/history/graph read only dependency state. `check/diff/explain` attempt current builders but degrade to explicit unavailable diagnostics instead of erasing state.
emergent_questions.decision: Diagnostic read-side remains available independently of current executable project code.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Resolved within P3 acceptance; no user decision required.

emergent_questions.question: How should receipt tampering be detected without sacrificing idempotent receipt identity?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Receipt IDs intentionally ignore recording time so exact retries can reuse the same logical receipt, but diagnostic timestamp/content still needs integrity checking.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Keep deterministic `receipt_id` over logical stable content and add `receipt_hash` over the full persisted receipt including `validated_at`.
emergent_questions.answer: Keep deterministic `receipt_id` over logical stable content and add `receipt_hash` over the full persisted receipt including `validated_at`.
emergent_questions.decision: Retries remain idempotent while edits to persisted receipt metadata/content are detectable.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Resolved within P3 acceptance; no user decision required.

emergent_questions.question: Should an explicit semantic/validation receipt also pin the revision of the target that was reviewed?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Without target identity, editing the reviewed document itself while upstream dependencies stay unchanged could leave an old validation receipt appearing current.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Yes. Explicit receipts automatically record the current target revision; a later target edit requires re-review (or becomes invalid if target is unavailable).
emergent_questions.answer: Yes. Explicit receipts automatically record the current target revision and compare it during check/diff.
emergent_questions.decision: `record_explicit` pins `target_revision`; target edits produce `target_changed_since_validation`, while an unavailable target produces `target_unavailable` and `invalid`.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Required for honest P4 semantic-review baselines; resolved within P3 acceptance.

emergent_questions.question: How strict must cross-link integrity be between state/events and their referenced receipt?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: A state/event can be syntactically valid yet claim changed dependencies that the referenced receipt never contained, making diagnostics non-explainable.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Validate that state/event targets match the receipt and every changed dependency is explainable by the receipt (or its builder revision pseudo-edge); persisted state is authoritative for the currently active receipt.
emergent_questions.answer: Cross-links are validated against the referenced receipt, including changed-dependency membership and active-receipt state identity.
emergent_questions.decision: `verify_integrity` rejects unknown changed dependencies, target mismatches, missing receipts and `valid` state over incomplete audit receipts. It does not infer current selection from receipt timestamps.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Strengthens P3-A6 / DAX14; resolved within P3 acceptance.

emergent_questions.question: Should persisted receipt/event parsing trust JSON coercions or enforce the schema-critical primitive types at runtime?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Coercing values such as the string `"false"` with Python truthiness can hide corruption and preserve a misleading audit status.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Enforce schema-critical types and canonical refs in the runtime parser; malformed persisted evidence is corruption, not a value to coerce.
emergent_questions.answer: Strict runtime parsing is required for receipt/event audit-critical fields.
emergent_questions.decision: Receipt/event loaders reject wrong primitive types, invalid source kinds and non-canonical event targets instead of coercing them.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Required for DAX03/DAX14 integrity; resolved within P3 acceptance.

emergent_questions.question: How should content-stable receipt identity coexist with repeated activation history when a target moves A → B → A?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: A content-stable receipt may legitimately be reused after an intervening receipt. Timestamp-based “latest receipt” selection and content-deduplicated events can then misidentify current state or erase the later re-activation from history.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Keep receipts content-stable, make persisted state authoritative for current selection, and give every real state mutation a monotonic state_revision that participates in event identity.
emergent_questions.answer: Use content-stable receipts for evidence identity and monotonic state_revision for transition-occurrence identity.
emergent_questions.decision: State, graph and integrity use the active receipt selected by persisted state. Every changed state increments state_revision; event IDs include that revision, so exact retries remain idempotent while A→B→A records all three occurrences.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Required for DAX07/DAX10/DAX14 correctness; resolved before post-acceptance handoff.

implementation_log.entry: Implemented content-addressed, versioned dependency-slice baseline storage under documentation-owned `_dependency/baselines`.
Implemented deterministic dependency receipts, receipt integrity hashes, current state and append-only event history.
Implemented exact/json_structured/sequence/set/text_unified comparators and typed deterministic diffs.
Implemented builder-revision invalidation and exact field/resource/file baseline comparison without using unrelated structured envelope metadata.
Implemented P3 CLI surfaces `status/check/diff/explain/history/graph` with JSON output and read-only/query mutation boundaries.
Added cross-link/corruption diagnostics for state → receipt → baseline and event → receipt/target.
Added whole-file plain Markdown dependency flow without introducing JSON and preserved semantic-review authority for human/AI.
acceptance correction: Explicit validation receipts now pin and compare target revision so editing the reviewed target cannot leave an old validation current.
acceptance correction: Integrity verification now checks state/event changed-dependency membership against receipts and state latest-receipt identity.
acceptance correction: Persisted receipt/event parsing now strictly validates audit-critical primitive types instead of coercing malformed JSON values.

post-acceptance axis correction: content-stable receipts can be re-activated after an intervening receipt; current selection now comes from persisted state and every real transition receives a monotonic state_revision used by event identity.
